answer: Deposits are visible in reef, and quill reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 59% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 157 aliases, and each one needs its own funded relic account. The per-identity price is 103 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
